currentContext.expansion: The Board approved a ₹100 crore strategic capital expenditure programme to be deployed over FY26 to FY28, described as the most significant capex programme in the company's history, covering: Extrusion Line Expansion (scaling up manufacturing capabilities for PVC and WPC profile extrusion lines), Dedicated Infrastructure (specialized manufacturing infrastructure for the growing aluminium glazing and windows division), and Modernization & Automation (upgrading and fully automating existing extrusion lines to maximize efficiency and precision). Approximately ₹27 crore of this programme was deployed during FY26, with the remaining deployment planned over FY27 and FY28 to further strengthen the manufacturing footprint and enable scaling into new categories (WPC Doors, WPC Wall & Ceiling Panels, Aluminium Windows, Doors & Glazing Systems). The company operates three manufacturing facilities: two at Jaipur (Rajasthan) and one at Bangalore (Karnataka).
